This design combines the optimization flexibility of continuous attacks with the semantic realism of discrete rephrasing-based attacks. Experiments demonstrate that REALISTA achieves superior or comparable performance to state-of-the-art realistic attacks on open-source LLMs and, crucially, succeeds in attacking large reasoning models under free-form response settings, where prior realistic attacks fail. Code is available at https://github.com/Buyun-Liang/REALISTA.

AI.tldr: 提出REALISTA框架，通过构建输入相关的有效编辑方向字典，在潜在空间中优化连续组合，生成语义等价且连贯的对抗性提示来诱发LLM幻觉，在开源和推理模型上均取得优于现有方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型易产生幻觉，需要真实的对抗性提示来触发这些失败。现有离散提示攻击搜索空间有限，而连续潜在空间攻击难以保证解码后的提示仍是有效的语义改写。
AI.method: 将幻觉诱发建模为约束优化问题，构建输入相关的有效编辑方向字典（对应语义等价且连贯的改写），在潜在空间中优化这些方向的连续组合，结合连续攻击的灵活性和离散改写的语义真实性。
AI.result: 在开源LLM上达到优于或可比于最先进真实攻击的性能，在大型推理模型的自由形式响应设置下成功攻击，而现有真实攻击方法在此场景下失败。
AI.conclusion: REALISTA通过结合连续攻击的优化灵活性与离散改写攻击的语义真实性，实现了更有效的幻觉诱发对抗攻击，尤其在推理模型上突破了此前方法的局限。

title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are now routinely deployed for visual understanding, generation, and curation. A substantial fraction of these applications require an explicit aesthetic judgment. Most existing solutions reduce this judgment to predicting a scalar score for a single image. We first ask whether such scores faithfully capture comparative preference: in a controlled study with eight expert annotators, score-derived rankings align poorly with the same annotators' direct comparisons, while direct ranking yields substantially higher inter-annotator agreement on best- and worst-image labels. Motivated by this finding, we introduce the Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB), which casts aesthetic evaluation as comparative selection over candidate sets with matched subject matter. VAB contains 400 tasks and 1,195 images across fine art, photography, and illustration, with labels derived from the consensus of 10 independent expert judges per task. Evaluating 20 frontier MLLMs and six dedicated visual-quality reward models, we find that the strongest system identifies both the best and the worst image correctly across three random permutations of the candidate order in only 26.5% of tasks, far below the 68.9% achieved by human experts. Fine-tuning a 35B-parameter model on 2,000 expert examples brings its accuracy close to that of a 397B-parameter open-weight model, suggesting that the comparative signal in VAB is transferable. Together, these results expose a clear and measurable gap between current multimodal models and expert aesthetic judgment, and VAB provides the first set-based, expert-grounded testbed on which that gap can be tracked and closed.

AI.tldr: 当前多模态大模型在审美判断上存在明显不足。本文通过受控实验发现，直接评分比标量分数更能反映人类偏好；据此构建了视觉审美基准(VAB)，包含400个任务、1195张图像，由10位专家标注。最强模型仅26.5%任务正确，远低于人类的68.9%。微调35B模型可使性能接近397B模型，表明VAB中的比较信号可迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs大多将审美判断简化为单图标量分数预测，但这种做法能否忠实捕捉人类的比较偏好尚不明确。作者希望通过受控实验验证这一问题，并构建更合理的评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 进行8位专家标注员的受控实验，比较分数排名与直接排名的一致性；2) 构建VAB基准，包含400个任务、1195张图像（涵盖美术、摄影、插画），每项任务由10位独立专家标注共识；3) 评估20个前沿MLLMs和6个专用视觉质量奖励模型。
AI.result: 最强系统在三次随机排列中同时选出最佳和最差图像的正确率仅26.5%，远低于人类专家的68.9%。在35B模型上使用2000个专家示例微调后，其准确率接近397B参数的开源模型。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型与专家审美判断之间存在可量化的显著差距，VAB提供了首个基于集合、专家标注的测试平台，可用于追踪和缩小这一差距。

title: Sustaining AI safety: Control-theoretic external impossibility, intrinsic necessity, and structural requirements
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable, safety strategies must be evaluated not only by how much they reduce present risk, but by whether they could sustain safety once external control can no longer reliably constrain system behavior. This paper addresses that problem by using control theory to clarify, at a structural level, whether externally enforced safety-sustaining strategies can succeed and, if not, what any alternative strategy would have to satisfy in order to be viable. It establishes two main results. First, under explicit premises including a reachability condition, it proves a class-wide external impossibility result: once the system's effects exceed what bounded external control can counteract, no strategy that depends in any degree on continued external enforcement can sustain AI safety. This failure is structural across the entire externally enforced class rather than contingent on any particular strategy. Second, it establishes a conditional class-level necessity result: if at least one candidate safety-sustaining strategy remains after that elimination, then all such remaining strategies must be intrinsic. It then states four structural requirements for viability: safety may not depend on continued external enforcement; the system's terminal objective must be safety-compatible when first formed; that objective must remain stable under self-modification; and safety must continue to be preserved as capability grows. The paper does not propose a complete strategy for sustaining AI safety. Its contribution is to give formal structure to a widely held concern about the limits of external control. It does so by deriving explicit conditional results that identify which safety-sustaining strategies are ruled out and what any remaining strategies must satisfy.

AI.tldr: 本文利用控制理论证明，在AI系统能力超越外部控制可抵消范围后，任何依赖外部强制执行的策略都将结构性地失效，剩余可行的安全维持策略必须满足内在性等四个必要条件。
AI.motivation: 现有安全策略评估多关注当前风险降低效果，但忽略了当外部控制不再可靠时策略是否仍能维持安全。本文旨在从控制理论视角结构性阐明这一问题。
AI.method: 采用控制理论方法，在可达性条件等明确前提假设下，对安全维持策略进行类级别分析，分别证明外部不可能性结果和内部必然性结果，并推导出四个结构性必要条件。
AI.result: 得到两个主要结果：（1）外部不可能性：一旦系统效应超出有限外部控制可抵消范围，任何依赖外部强制执行的策略都无法持续维持安全，此失效是结构性的；（2）内在必然性：排除外部依赖策略后，剩余可行策略必须满足内在性特征。进一步给出四个结构性必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文未提出完整的安全策略方案，但通过形式化推导，为"外部控制存在根本局限"这一广泛担忧提供了严谨的结构性论证，明确了哪些策略被排除以及剩余策略必须满足的条件。

title: Persona-Model Collapse in Emergent Misalignment
summary: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow data with harmful content produces broadly misaligned behavior on unrelated prompts, a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment. We propose that emergent misalignment involves persona-model collapse: deterioration of the model's internal capacity to simulate, differentiate, and maintain consistent characters. We test this hypothesis behaviorally using two metrics: moral susceptibility (S) and moral robustness (R), computed from the across- and within-persona variability of models' Moral Foundations Questionnaire responses under persona role-play. These metrics formalize the model's ability to differentiate characters (S) and its consistency when simulating a given one (R). We evaluate four frontier models (DeepSeek-V3.1, GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, Qwen3-235B) in three variants: base, fine-tuned to output insecure code, and a matched control fine-tuned to output secure code. Across the four models, insecure fine-tuning produces an average $55\%$ increase in S, pushing all four insecure variants beyond the band observed across 13 frontier models benchmarked in prior work -- with GPT-4o reaching more than twice the band's upper end -- signaling dysregulated differentiation. It also causes an average $65\%$ decrease in R, equivalent to a $304\%$ increase in 1/R. By contrast, the matched secure control preserves S near the base and induces only a partial R loss, showing that these effects are largely misalignment-specific. Complementing these metric shifts, insecure variants' unconditioned responses converge toward saturation near the scale ceiling, departing markedly from both base models' structured responses and those elicited when base models role-play toxic personas. Taken together, these metrics provide a sensitive diagnostic for emergent misalignment and serve as behavioral evidence that it involves persona-model collapse.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，大语言模型在有害数据上微调产生的"涌现性失调"现象，本质上是"人格模型崩溃"——模型模拟、区分和维持一致角色的内部能力退化。作者提出两个行为指标（道德敏感性S和道德稳健性R）来量化该现象，并在四个前沿模型上验证，发现有害微调导致S平均增加55%、R平均下降65%，而安全微调几乎不产生影响。
AI.motivation: 解释大语言模型在窄域有害数据上微调后，为何会在无关提示上产生广泛失调行为（即"涌现性失调"）背后的机制。
AI.method: 提出两个行为指标：道德敏感性（S，衡量区分不同角色的能力）和道德稳健性（R，衡量同一角色下回答的一致性），通过模型在角色扮演下填写道德基础问卷的得分变异计算得出。在四个前沿模型（DeepSeek-V3.1、GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、Qwen3-235B）的三种变体（基础版、不安全代码微调版、安全代码微调对照版）上进行测试。
AI.result: 不安全微调导致S平均增加55%（GPT-4o超过先前13个前沿模型基准上限的两倍），R平均下降65%（1/R增加304%）。安全对照微调几乎不改变S，仅部分降低R。不安全变体的无条件响应趋近量表天花板，与基础模型和基础模型扮演有毒角色的响应模式不同。
AI.conclusion: S和R指标可作为涌现性失调的敏感诊断工具，行为证据支持该现象涉及人格模型崩溃。

title: MMCL-Bench: Multimodal Context Learning from Visual Rules, Procedures, and Evidence
summary: We introduce MMCL-Bench, a benchmark for multimodal context learning: learning task-local rules, procedures, and empirical patterns from visual or mixed-modality teaching context and applying them to new visual instances. Unlike text-only context learning or standard multimodal question answering, this setting requires models to recover and localize relevant evidence from images, screenshots, manuals, videos, and frame sequences before they can reason over the learned context. MMCL-Bench contains 102 tasks spanning three categories: rule system application, procedural task execution, and empirical discovery and induction. We evaluate frontier multimodal models with strict rubric-based scoring and find that current systems remain far from robust multimodal context learning, with even the strongest model solving fewer than one-third of tasks under strict evaluation. Diagnostic ablations and error analysis show that failures arise throughout the context-to-answer pipeline, including context anchoring, visual evidence extraction, context reasoning, and response construction. MMCL-Bench thus highlights multimodal context learning as an important unsolved capability bottleneck for current multimodal models.

AI.tldr: MMCL-Bench是一个用于评估多模态上下文学习能力的基准测试，包含102个任务，涵盖规则系统应用、程序任务执行和经验发现归纳三类。当前最强模型在严格评估下仅能解决不足三分之一的任务，表明多模态上下文学习仍是当前模型的重要能力瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对多模态上下文学习的专门评估——模型需要从图像、截图、手册、视频等视觉或混合模态教学上下文中学习局部规则、程序和经验模式，并将其应用于新的视觉实例，这与纯文本上下文学习或标准多模态问答有本质区别。
AI.method: 构建包含102个任务的MMCL-Bench基准，任务分为三类：规则系统应用、程序任务执行、经验发现与归纳。采用严格的基于评分标准的评估方法，对前沿多模态模型进行系统评估。
AI.result: 当前最强模型在严格评估下只能解决不到三分之一的测试任务。错误分析表明，失败贯穿整个上下文到答案的流程，包括上下文锚定、视觉证据提取、上下文推理和响应构建等环节。
AI.conclusion: 多模态上下文学习是当前多模态模型尚未解决的关键能力瓶颈，MMCL-Bench揭示了现有模型在这一能力上的显著不足。

title: Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI
summary: Is monolithic scaling the only path to AGI? This paper challenges the dogma that purely scaling a single model is sufficient to achieve Artificial General Intelligence. Instead, we identify Agentic AI as a necessary paradigm for mastering the complex, heterogeneous distribution of real-world tasks. Through rigorous theoretical derivations, we contrast the optimization constraints of monolithic learners against the efficiency of Agentic systems, progressing from simple routing mechanisms to general Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) topologies. We demonstrate that Agentic AI achieves exponentially superior generalization and sample efficiency. Finally, we discuss the connection to Mixture-of-Experts, reinterpret the instability of current multi-agent frameworks, and call for greater research focus on Agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了单体缩放不足以实现AGI，提出Agentic AI（特别是DAG拓扑结构）是实现通用人工智能的必要范式，并证明其在泛化和样本效率上具有指数级优势。
AI.motivation: 挑战"仅靠单一模型规模化就能实现AGI"的主流观点，指出真实世界任务的复杂异质性需要更灵活的范式。
AI.method: 通过严谨的理论推导，对比单体学习器与Agentic系统的优化约束，从简单路由机制推广到通用有向无环图（DAG）拓扑。
AI.result: 证明Agentic AI在泛化能力和样本效率上具有指数级优势。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI是实现AGI的必要范式，应加大研究投入；同时讨论了与混合专家模型的联系，并重新解释了当前多智能体框架的不稳定性。

title: CiteVQA: Benchmarking Evidence Attribution for Trustworthy Document Intelligence
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced document understanding, yet current Doc-VQA evaluations score only the final answer and leave the supporting evidence unchecked. This answer-only approach masks a critical failure mode: a model can land on the correct answer while grounding it in the wrong passage -- a critical risk in high-stakes domains like law, finance, and medicine, where every conclusion must be traceable to a specific source region. To address this, we introduce CiteVQA, a benchmark that requires models to return element-level bounding-box citations alongside each answer, evaluating both jointly. CiteVQA comprises 1,897 questions across 711 PDFs spanning seven domains and two languages, averaging 40.6 pages per document. To ensure fidelity and scalability, the ground-truth citations are generated by an automated pipeline-which identifies crucial evidence via masking ablation-and are subsequently validated through expert review. At the core of our evaluation is Strict Attributed Accuracy (SAA), which credits a prediction only when the answer and the cited region are both correct. Auditing 20 MLLMs reveals a pervasive Attribution Hallucination: models frequently produce the right answer while citing the wrong region. The strongest system (Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview) achieves an SAA of only 76.0, and the strongest open-source MLLM reaches just 22.5. Ultimately, towards trustworthy document intelligence, CiteVQA exposes a reliability gap that answer-only evaluations overlook, providing the instrumentation needed to close it. Our repository is available at https://github.com/opendatalab/CiteVQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CiteVQA基准，要求多模态大模型在文档问答中不仅给出答案，还需提供元素级边界框引用，并联合评估两者。揭示模型普遍存在"归因幻觉"：答案正确但引用区域错误。最强模型Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的严格归因准确率仅76.0，开源模型仅22.5。
AI.motivation: 现有Doc-VQA评估仅关注最终答案正确性，忽视了模型可能将正确答案错误地指向错误文本段落的关键缺陷。在金融、法律等高风险领域，结论必须追溯到具体信息来源，现有评价方式无法保证可信度。
AI.method: 构建CiteVQA基准：包含1,897个问题、711份PDF，覆盖7个领域和2种语言，平均每份文档40.6页。通过基于掩码消融的自动化流水线生成地面真值引用，并经专家审核验证。提出严格归因准确率（SAA）指标，仅当答案和引用区域同时正确时才计分。
AI.result: 评估20个多模态大模型，发现普遍存在归因幻觉。最强系统Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的SAA仅76.0，最强开源模型仅22.5。
AI.conclusion: CiteVQA暴露了仅评估答案所忽视的可靠性差距，为构建可信的文档智能提供了必要的评估工具。

title: Inline Critic Steers Image Editing
summary: Instruction-based image editing exhibits heterogeneous difficulty not only across cases but also across regions of an image, motivating refinement approaches that allocate correction to where the model struggles. Existing refinement signals arrive late, after a fully generated image or a completed denoising step. We ask whether such a signal can act within an ongoing forward pass. To investigate this, we probe a frozen image-editing model and find that although generation capability emerges only in the last few layers, the error pattern is already set in early layers (rank correlation \r{ho} = 0.83 with the final-layer error map). Based on this, we introduce Inline Critic, a learnable token that critiques a frozen model's predictions at its intermediate layers and steers its hidden states to refine generation during the forward pass. A three-stage recipe is proposed to stabilize the training from learning how to critique to steering generation. As a result, we achieve state of the art on GEdit-Bench (7.89), a +9.4 gain on RISEBench over the same backbone, and the strongest open-source result on KRIS-Bench (81.92, surpassing GPT-4o). We further provide analyses showing that the critic genuinely shapes the model's attention and prediction updates at subsequent layers.

AI.tldr: 提出Inline Critic，一种可在前向传播过程中实时 critique 并修正图像编辑模型中间层表示的可学习token，实现SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有图像编辑的 refinement 信号只能在完整生成图像或完成一个去噪步骤后才能获得，无法在模型前向传播过程中进行实时修正。
AI.method: 1) 发现错误模式在早期层已确立（rank correlation ρ=0.83）；2) 提出Inline Critic，一个可学习token，在中间层 critique 预测并 steering 隐藏状态；3) 设计三阶段训练方案稳定从 critique 学习到生成引导的过渡。
AI.result: GEdit-Bench 7.89（SOTA），RISEBench 提升 +9.4，KRIS-Bench 81.92（超越GPT-4o）。
AI.conclusion: Inline Critic能够在前向传播中实时修正模型，且能真正影响后续层的注意力机制和预测更新。

title: Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for knowledge-intensive question answering, but existing systems remain brittle on multi-hop questions, where solving the task requires chaining multiple retrieval and reasoning steps. Key challenges are that current methods represent reasoning through free-form natural language, where intermediate states are implicit, retrieval queries can drift from intended entities, and errors are detected by the same model that produces them making self-reflection an unreliable, ungrounded signal.
  We observe that multi-hop question answering is a typical form of step-by-step computation, and that this structured process aligns closely with how code-specialized language models are trained to operate. Motivated by this, we introduce \pyrag, a framework that reformulates multi-hop RAG as program synthesis and execution. Instead of free-form reasoning trajectories, \pyrag represents the reasoning process as an executable Python program over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states as variables, producing deterministic feedback through execution, and yielding an inspectable trace of the entire reasoning process. This formulation further enables compiler-grounded self-repair and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without any additional training.
  Experiments on five QA benchmarks (PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle) show that \pyrag consistently outperforms strong baselines under both training-free and RL-trained settings, with especially large gains on compositional multi-hop datasets. Our code, data and models are publicly available at https://github.com/GasolSun36/PyRAG.

AI.tldr: PyRAG将多跳RAG转化为Python程序合成与执行，通过可编程的中间状态、确定性反馈和编译器引导的自修复，显著提升了多跳问答的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统在多跳问答中表现脆弱，主要问题包括：自由形式自然语言推理导致中间状态隐式化、检索查询易偏离目标实体、自反思信号不可靠且缺乏基础。
AI.method: 提出PyRAG框架，将多跳RAG重新定义为程序合成与执行：将推理过程表示为可执行的Python程序（调用检索和QA工具），中间状态作为显式变量，通过执行产生确定性反馈，并支持编译器引导的自修复和执行驱动的自适应检索，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和Bamboogle五个基准测试中，PyRAG在无训练和RL训练设置下均持续优于强基线，在组合多跳数据集上提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将多跳推理形式化为程序合成能够有效解决自由形式推理的固有问题，提供更可靠、可检查且可修复的推理过程。

title: CommonWhy: A Dataset for Evaluating Entity-Based Causal Commonsense Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: To effectively interact with the real world, Large Language Models (LLMs) require entity-based commonsense reasoning, a challenging task that necessitates integrating factual knowledge about specific entities with commonsense inference. Existing datasets for evaluating LLM entity-based commonsense reasoning have largely focused on True/False or multiple-choice questions, leaving the explicit assessment of the model's ability in abductive reasoning about causes and effects and generating explanations largely unexamined. In this work, we introduce CommonWhy, a dataset of 15,000 why questions designed to evaluate entity-based commonsense reasoning about causal relationships in LLMs. CommonWhy also serves as a Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) benchmark, as all supporting knowledge required to answer its queries is available in the Wikidata knowledge graph. Unlike existing KGQA datasets, which primarily test fact retrieval, CommonWhy targets causal commonsense reasoning, establishing a new paradigm for KGQA evaluation. Experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs and LLM-based KGQA methods reveal their significant shortcomings, including frequent factual hallucinations and failures in causal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CommonWhy数据集，包含15,000个"为什么"问题，用于评估大语言模型在基于实体的常识因果推理能力。同时作为知识图谱问答基准，实验发现现有模型存在事实幻觉和因果推理失败等问题。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集多集中在True/False或选择题形式，缺乏对模型在因果溯因推理和生成解释能力方面的显式评估。
AI.method: 构建包含15,000个"为什么"问题的CommonWhy数据集，所有支持知识均来自Wikidata知识图谱，可用于KGQA基准测试。
AI.result: 最先进的LLM和基于LLM的KGQA方法在CommonWhy上表现不佳，存在频繁的事实幻觉和因果推理失败问题。
AI.conclusion: CommonWhy建立了KGQA评估的新范式，从事实检索转向因果常识推理，揭示了现有模型在该任务上的显著不足。

title: Is Video Anomaly Detection Misframed? Evidence from LLM-Based and Multi-Scene Models
summary: Recent video anomaly detection research has expanded rapidly with an emphasis on general models of normality intended to work across many different scenes. While this focus has led to improvements in scalability and multi-scene generalization, it has also shifted the field away from modeling the scene-specific and context-dependent nature of normal behavior. Contemporary approaches frequently rely on video-level weak supervision and opaque pretrained representations from multi-modal large language models (MLLMs), which encourage models to respond to familiar semantic anomaly categories rather than to deviations from the normal patterns of a particular environment. This trend suppresses spatial localization, introduces semantic bias, and reduces anomaly detection to a form of action recognition. In this paper, we examine whether these prevailing formulations align with the core requirements of real-world VAD, which is typically performed within a single scene where normality is determined by local geometry, semantics, and activity patterns. Through targeted visual analyses and empirical evaluations, we demonstrate the practical consequences of these limitations and show that meaningful progress in VAD requires renewed focus on single-scene, spatially-aware, and explainable formulations that capture the nuanced structure of normality within individual environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判当前视频异常检测（VAD）研究过度追求多场景通用性，依赖弱监督和MLLM预训练表征，导致模型忽略场景特异性、缺乏空间定位、存在语义偏差，实际上退化为动作识别。作者呼吁回归单场景、空间感知、可解释的VAD范式。
AI.motivation: 当前VAD研究方向偏离了真实应用场景的核心需求。现实中的VAD通常针对单一场景，正常行为由局部几何、语义和活动模式决定，但主流方法追求多场景泛化，导致模型无法捕捉场景特异性的正常模式。
AI.method: 通过目标性视觉分析和实证评估，系统性地比较当前主流VAD方法与单场景、空间感知方法之间的差异，揭示现有方法的局限性及其实际后果。
AI.result: 现有VAD方法存在三大问题：1) 弱监督和MLLM表征引入语义偏差，使检测退化为动作识别；2) 缺乏空间定位能力；3) 无法捕捉场景特异性的正常模式。这些局限性在单场景真实应用中表现明显。
AI.conclusion: 有意义的VAD进展需要回归单场景、空间感知且可解释的公式化方法，以捕捉个体环境中正常行为的细微结构。

title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
summary: Learning from past experience benefits from two complementary forms of memory: episodic traces -- raw trajectories of what happened -- and consolidated abstractions distilled across many episodes into reusable, schema-like lessons. Recent agentic-memory systems pursue the consolidated form: an LLM rewrites past trajectories into a textual memory bank that it continuously updates with new interactions, promising self-improving agents without parameter updates. Yet we find that such consolidated memories produced by today's LLMs are often faulty even when derived from useful experiences. As consolidation proceeds, memory utility first rises, then degrades, and can fall below the no-memory baseline. More surprisingly, even when consolidating from ground-truth solutions, GPT-5.4 fails on 54% of a set of ARC-AGI problems it had previously solved without memory. We trace the regression to the consolidation step rather than the underlying experience: the same trajectories yield qualitatively different memories under different update schedules, and an episodic-only control that simply retains those trajectories remains competitive with the consolidators we test. In a controlled ARC-AGI Stream environment that exposes Retain, Delete, and Consolidate actions, agents preserve raw episodes by default and double the accuracy of their forced-consolidation counterparts; disabling consolidation entirely (episodic management only) matches this auto regime. Practically, robust agent memory should treat raw episodes as first-class evidence and gate consolidation explicitly rather than firing it after every interaction. Looking forward, reliable agentic memory will require LLMs that can consolidate without overwriting the evidence they depend on.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，当前LLM基于经验整合的抽象记忆会随时间退化，甚至低于无记忆基线。而保留原始经验轨迹的 episodic 记忆不仅更可靠，且性能优于强制整合的记忆系统。
AI.motivation: 探索智能体记忆系统中，基于经验整合的抽象记忆（consolidated memory）是否优于直接保留原始轨迹（episodic memory），并揭示当前LLM在记忆整合过程中的根本缺陷。
AI.method: 在ARC-AGI Stream环境中设计Retain、Delete和Consolidate三种动作，对比不同记忆更新策略（强制整合 vs. 自动保留 vs. 仅episodic管理）对智能体性能的影响，并分析GPT-5.4在整合记忆前后的表现退化。
AI.result: 1) 整合记忆的效用先上升后下降，最终低于无记忆基线；2) GPT-5.4在整合真实解时，对之前已解决的ARC-AGI问题失败率达54%；3) 不同更新策略导致同一轨迹产生不同质量的记忆；4) 保留原始episodic轨迹的智能体性能达到整合策略的两倍；5) 完全禁用整合（仅episodic管理）与自动保留策略效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 健壮的智能体记忆应将原始经验轨迹作为一级证据，显式控制整合时机而非每次交互后强制整合。未来需要能够在不覆盖依赖证据的前提下进行可靠整合的LLM。

title: ATD-Trans: A Geographically Grounded Japanese-English Travelogue Translation Dataset
summary: Geographic text, or textual data rich in geographic (geo-) information is a valuable source for various geographic applications, e.g., tourism management. Making such information accessible to speakers of other languages further enhances its utility; thus, accurate machine translation (MT) is essential for equity in multilingual geo-information access. To facilitate in-depth analysis for geographic text, we introduce ATD-Trans, a geographically grounded Japanese--English travelogue translation dataset, which enables evaluation of MT quality at both the overall and geo-entity levels across domestic (within Japan) and overseas regions. Our experiments on existing language models examine two factors: model language focus and geographic regions. The results highlight advantages of Japanese-enhanced models and greater difficulty in translating domestic-region geo-entities mentioned in travel blogs.

AI.tldr: 提出了ATD-Trans数据集，用于评估日语-英语旅游博客翻译质量，发现日语增强模型表现更好，且国内地理实体翻译更具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 地理文本的多语言翻译对公平获取地理信息至关重要，但缺乏专门针对地理文本翻译质量评估的数据集。
AI.method: 构建了ATD-Trans日英旅游博客翻译数据集，设计总体和地理实体两级评估，在现有语言模型上实验分析语言焦点和地理区域两个因素。
AI.result: 日语增强模型表现更优；国内地理实体（日本境内）的翻译比海外地理实体更难。
AI.conclusion: ATD-Trans数据集可用于地理文本翻译质量分析，且地理实体翻译难度存在区域差异性。

title: Just Ask for a Table: A Thirty-Token User Prompt Defeats Sponsored Recommendations in Twelve LLMs
comment: Submitted to Workshop on Textual Information Processing & Synthesis in the Wild
summary: Wu et al. (2026) showed that most frontier large language models (LLMs) recommend a sponsored, roughly twice-as-expensive flight when their system prompt contains a soft sponsorship cue. We reproduce their evaluation on ten open-weight chat models plus the two of their twenty-three models that are still reachable today (gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4o). All reported rates in this paper are produced under the same judge the original paper used (gpt-4o); we additionally store every label under an open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) and a smaller proprietary (gpt-4o-mini) judge for an ablation. Three findings emerge. First, a prose description of an LLM evaluation pipeline is not, on its own, sufficient for accurate reproduction: we surfaced three silent implementation failures that each shifted a reported rate by tens of percentage points. Second, the central claims do generalise - the gpt-3.5-turbo logistic-regression intercept of alpha = 0.81 is within four points of the original alpha = 0.86, and 200 of 200 trials on gpt-3.5-turbo and gpt-4o promote a payday lender to a financially distressed user. Third, a thirty-token user prompt that asks the assistant for a neutral comparison table first cuts sponsored recommendation from 46.9% to 1.0% averaged across our ten open-source models, and from 53.0% to 0% averaged across the two OpenAI models. AI literacy and price-comparison portals are likely market-level mitigations; the harmful-product cell is bounded by neither. Raw data, labels and analysis scripts are at https://github.com/akmaier/Paper-LLM-Ads .

AI.tldr: 本文复现了Wu等人(2026)的研究，发现大多数前沿LLM在系统提示中含有软赞助提示时会推荐更贵的赞助产品。复现证实了原始发现的可推广性，同时发现仅靠文字描述不足以准确复现实验（存在三个隐性实现错误），并发现一个30词的提示可将赞助推荐率从46.9%降至1.0%。
AI.motivation: 验证Wu等人(2026)关于LLM在软赞助提示下会推荐更贵产品的核心主张是否可推广和可复现，并探究复现过程中的潜在问题及缓解措施。
AI.method: 对十个开源聊天模型及两个OpenAI模型（gpt-3.5-turbo、gpt-4o）进行复现评估；使用原论文的gpt-4o评判器，并增加gpt-oss-120b和gpt-4o-mini两个评判器进行消融实验。
AI.result: 1) 仅靠文字描述无法准确复现，发现三个隐性实现错误使结果偏差数十个百分点；2) 核心主张可推广，gpt-3.5-turbo的逻辑回归截距与原结果相差在4个点以内，200次试验均向财务困境用户推荐高利贷；3) 30词提示可将赞助推荐率从46.9%降至1.0%（开源模型），从53.0%降至0%（OpenAI模型）。
AI.conclusion: AI素养和价格比较平台可能是有效的市场级缓解措施，但对有害产品类别效果有限。数据和代码已开源。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Tutoring for Algorithm Tracing and Problem-Solving in AI Education
comment: Paper accepted to the 21st Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Applications (BEA 2026), co-located with ACL 2026
summary: Students learning algorithms often need support as they interpret traces, debug reasoning errors, and apply procedures across unfamiliar problem instances. In this paper, we present KITE (Knowledge-Informed Tutoring Engine), a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based intelligent tutoring system designed to serve as a classroom teaching assistant for algorithmic reasoning and problem-solving tasks. KITE uses an intent-aware Socratic response strategy to tailor support to different student needs, responding with targeted hints, guiding questions, and progressive scaffolding intended to strengthen students' algorithmic problem-solving ability. To keep responses aligned with course content, KITE uses a multimodal RAG pipeline that retrieves relevant information from course materials. We evaluate KITE using three forms of assessment: RAGAs-based metrics for response grounding and quality, expert evaluation of pedagogical quality, and a simulated student pipeline in which a weaker language model interacts with KITE across two-turn dialogues and produces revised answers after receiving feedback. Results indicate that KITE produces contextually grounded and pedagogically appropriate responses. Further, using simulated students, KITE's feedback helped the student models produce more accurate follow-up responses on procedural and tracing questions, suggesting that its scaffolding can support algorithmic problem-solving. This work contributes a tutoring architecture and an evaluation approach for assessing retrieval-grounded explanations and scaffolded problem-solving feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KITE，一个基于RAG的智能辅导系统，通过意图感知的苏格拉底式回应策略和多模态检索增强生成管道，为学生的算法推理和问题解决提供支架式辅导。评估表明其在上下文相关性、教学质量方面表现良好，并能有效帮助学生改进回答。
AI.motivation: 学习算法的学生在解释执行轨迹、调试推理错误以及将算法程序应用于不熟悉的问题实例时，常常需要额外的支持。现有系统在这方面的能力有限，因此需要一种能提供个性化、上下文相关辅导的智能系统。
AI.method: KITE采用意图感知的苏格拉底回应策略，根据学生的不同需求提供针对性提示、引导性问题和渐进式支架。系统通过多模态RAG管道从课程资料中检索相关信息，确保回应与课程内容一致。
AI.result: RAGAs指标评估了回应接地性和质量；专家评估验证了教学法适当性；模拟学生管线实验表明，KITE的反馈帮助弱势语言模型在程序追踪问题上产生更准确的修正回答。
AI.conclusion: KITE能够产生上下文相关且教学上适当的回应，其支架式反馈可有效支持算法问题解决。该工作贡献了一种辅导架构以及一种评估检索接地解释和支架式问题解决反馈的方法。

title: DiM\textsuperscript{3}: Bridging Multilingual and Multimodal Models via Direction- and Magnitude-Aware Merging
summary: Towards more general and human-like intelligence, large language models should seamlessly integrate both multilingual and multimodal capabilities; however, extending an existing multimodal model to many languages typically requires expensive multilingual multimodal data construction and repeated end-to-end retraining. We study a training-free alternative: injecting multilingual capability into an existing multimodal model by composing residual updates in the shared language model backbone. The key challenge is that multilingual and multimodal updates are heterogeneous, reflecting different functional roles in the shared model. To address this, we propose Direction- and Magnitude-aware Multilingual Multimodal merging (DiM3), which selectively composes the two updates at each parameter dimension while preserving the original vision encoder and multimodal projector. Experiments on multilingual benchmarks in both text-only and vision-language settings, covering 57 languages across LLaVA- and Qwen-based backbones, show that DiM3 consistently outperforms existing merging baselines, substantially improves multilingual performance over the original multimodal model, and remains competitive with dedicated multilingual multimodal fine-tuning while largely retaining general multimodal ability. We further show that DiM3 can be directly applied to already trained multilingual multimodal models and still yield additional gains. Further interpretability analysis shows that DiM3 primarily reshapes intermediate-layer semantic representations, strengthening cross-lingual alignment under both text-only and multimodal inputs while preserving higher-layer task-sensitive structure. Our repository is on https://github.com/wzj1718/DiM3.

AI.tldr: 提出DiM3方法，通过方向与幅度感知的多语言多模态融合技术，在不重新训练的情况下将多语言能力注入现有多模态大模型，在57种语言上取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型扩展多语言能力需要昂贵的多语言多模态数据构建和端到端重训练，作者希望探索一种无需训练的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出DiM3（Direction- and Magnitude-aware Multilingual Multimodal merging），通过选择性组合多语言更新和多模态更新的残差更新，在共享语言模型骨干的每个参数维度上进行融合，同时保留原始视觉编码器和多模态投影器。
AI.result: 在LLaVA和Qwen骨干网络上覆盖57种语言的文本-only和视觉-语言基准测试中，DiM3持续优于现有融合基线，显著提升多语言性能，与专用多语言多模态微调方法竞争力相当，且能保持通用多模态能力。该方法还可直接应用于已训练的多语言多模态模型并带来额外增益。
AI.conclusion: DiM3主要通过重塑中间层语义表示来增强跨语言对齐（包括纯文本和多模态输入），同时保留高层任务敏感结构，为实现更通用、更类人的多语言多模态智能提供了高效路径。

title: MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning
summary: Current interactive LLM agents rely on goal-conditioned stepwise planning, where environmental understanding is acquired reactively during execution rather than established beforehand. This temporal inversion leads to Delayed Environmental Perception: agents must infer environmental constraints through trial-and-error, resulting in an Epistemic Bottleneck that traps them in inefficient failure cycles. Inspired by human affordance perception and cognitive map theory, we propose the Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP), a plug-and-play framework that shifts environment understanding before execution. MAP consists of three stages: (1) Global Exploration, acquiring environment-general priors; (2) Task-Specific Mapping, constructing a structured cognitive map; and (3) Knowledge-Augmented Execution, solving tasks grounded on the map. Experiments show consistent gains across benchmarks and LLMs. On ARC-AGI-3, MAP enables frontier models to surpass near-zero baseline performance in 22 of 25 game environments. We further introduce MAP-2K, a dataset of map-then-act trajectories, and show that training on it outperforms expert execution traces, suggesting that understanding environments is more fundamental than imitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP)，一种将环境理解前置的框架，通过全局探索、任务特定映射和知识增强执行三个阶段，使LLM代理先构建认知地图再执行任务，有效解决了传统交互式代理因延迟环境感知导致的试错循环问题。实验表明MAP在多个基准和LLM上取得一致提升，且基于MAP轨迹训练的模型优于直接模仿专家执行轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有交互式LLM代理采用目标条件化的逐步规划方式，环境理解在执行过程中被动获取（即"延迟环境感知"），导致代理需要通过试错来推断环境约束，陷入低效的失败循环（认知瓶颈）。
AI.method: 提出Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP)框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 全局探索——获取环境通用先验知识；(2) 任务特定映射——构建结构化认知地图；(3) 知识增强执行——基于地图完成任务求解。该框架受人类可供性感知和认知地图理论启发，是一种即插即用的方案。
AI.result: 在多个基准和LLM上取得一致性能提升。在ARC-AGI-3上，MAP使前沿模型在22/25个游戏环境中超越了接近零的基线性能。引入MAP-2K数据集，基于该数据集训练优于直接使用专家执行轨迹训练。
AI.conclusion: 理解环境比模仿执行更为根本——先构建环境认知地图再执行任务，比直接模仿专家执行轨迹更有效。

title: Leveraging Speech to Identify Signatures of Insight and Transfer in Problem Solving
summary: Many problems seem to require a flash of insight to solve. What form do these sudden insights take, and what impact do they have on how people approach similar problems in the future? In this work, we prompted participants (N = 189) to talk aloud as they attempted to solve a sequence of five "matchstick-arithmetic" problems. These problems either all relied on the same kind of non-obvious solution (Same group) or a different kind each time (Different group). We found that Same participants improved more rapidly than Different participants, and as they improved, they talked more and talked about different things when solving later problems. Specifically, they were more likely to spontaneously categorize the problem they were working on. Taken together, these findings suggest that a hallmark of transferable insights is their accessibility for verbal report, even if the underlying precursors of insight remain difficult to articulate.

AI.tldr: 研究通过火柴棒算术问题实验发现，当问题依赖相同类型的非显性解法时，参与者能更快掌握规律，并且更倾向于自发对问题进行分类，说明可迁移的顿悟具有可言语化的特征。
AI.motivation: 探索顿悟（insight）在问题解决中的具体表现形式，以及顿悟如何影响人们未来处理类似问题的方式。
AI.method: 招募189名参与者，要求他们边思考边大声说出来，尝试解决一系列5个火柴棒算术问题。参与者分为两组：Same组（所有问题依赖同一种非显性解法）和Different组（每个问题依赖不同的非显性解法）。
AI.result: Same组参与者比Different组进步更快；随着进步，Same组在解决后续问题时说话更多、内容不同，并且更倾向于自发对问题进行归类。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移的顿悟（transferable insights）的一个标志是其可被言语报告，尽管顿悟背后的前因过程仍难以清晰表达。

title: FRAME: Forensic Routing and Adaptive Multi-path Evidence Fusion for Image Manipulation Detection
summary: The proliferation of sophisticated image editing tools and generative artificial intelligence models has made verifying the authenticity of digital images increasingly challenging, with important implications for journalism, forensic analysis, and public trust. Although numerous forensic algorithms, ranging from handcrafted methods to deep learning-based detectors, have been developed for manipulation detection, individual methods often suffer from limited robustness, fragmented evidence, or weak generalization across manipulation types and image conditions. To address these limitations, we present \textbf{FRAME}, a method for \textbf{F}orensic \textbf{R}outing and \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{M}ulti-path \textbf{E}vidence fusion for image manipulation detection. FRAME organizes diverse forensic algorithms into a multi-path analysis space, adaptively selects informative forensic paths for each input image, and fuses complementary evidence to improve detection and localization performance. By moving beyond single-method analysis and fixed fusion strategies, FRAME provides a more robust and flexible approach to image forensic reasoning while preserving interpretable forensic cues from multiple evidence sources. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of FRAME across diverse manipulation scenarios. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kzhao5/FRAME}{https://github.com/kzhao5/FRAME}.

AI.tldr: FRAME是一种通过多路径分析和自适应证据融合来提升图像篡改检测鲁棒性与泛化能力的方法，在多种篡改场景下表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有图像篡改检测方法（手工特征或深度学习）存在鲁棒性有限、证据碎片化、泛化能力弱等问题，亟需更灵活、鲁棒的融合框架。
AI.method: FRAME构建多路径分析空间，集成多种取证算法；对每张输入图像自适应选择信息量最大的取证路径；融合互补证据，同时保持各证据源的可解释性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明FRAME在多种篡改场景下均有效，性能优于单一方法及固定融合策略。
AI.conclusion: FRAME通过自适应多路径证据融合，为图像取证提供了一种更鲁棒、灵活且可解释的解决方案，并已开源代码。

title: Leveraging Multimodal Self-Consistency Reasoning in Coding Motivational Interviewing for Alcohol Use Reduction
summary: BACKGROUND: Coding Motivational Interviewing (MI) sessions is essential for understanding client behaviors and predicting outcomes, but it requires substantial time and labor from trained MI professionals. Recent advances in audio-language models (ALMs) offer new opportunities to automate MI coding by capturing multimodal behavioral signals. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to develop an automatic MI coding approach based on ALMs that analyzes raw audio input and integrates predictions from multiple reasoning trajectories using self-consistency to improve coding robustness. METHODS: We experimented with five recorded sessions from de-identified MI audio tapes. We deployed ALMs with four complementary analytic prompts to support utterance-level reasoning: analytic prompting for verbal cues, prosody-aware prompting for acoustic cues, evidence-scoring prompting for quantitative hypothesis testing, and comparative prompting for contrastive reasoning. Three stochastic samples were drawn for each prompt, generating 12 independent reasoning trajectories per utterance. Final predictions were determined by majority voting across all trajectories. RESULTS: Performance was evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and macro-F1 scores. The proposed multimodal self-consistency approach achieved 52.56% accuracy, 54.03% precision, 47.45% recall, and a macro-F1 score of 46.40%, exceeding baseline methods. Systematic ablation experiments that removed individual modules consistently degraded performance on the primary metrics. CONCLUSIONS: Multimodal self-consistency outperforms single-pass baseline prompting approaches for MI coding. These findings suggest that incorporating both what clients say and how they say it can support more reliable automatic MI coding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于音频语言模型的多模态自一致性方法，用于自动化动机性访谈编码。通过四种互补提示策略和多数投票机制，该方法在原始音频输入上实现了比基线更好的编码性能，准确率达52.56%。
AI.motivation: 动机性访谈编码对于理解来访者行为和预测治疗结果至关重要，但传统的手工编码需要大量时间和专业人力。近年来音频语言模型的发展为自动化编码提供了新机遇，因此本研究旨在开发一种自动化的MI编码方法，以减轻人工负担并提高编码效率。
AI.method: 研究使用5个去标识化的MI录音会话，部署了四种互补的提示策略：言语线索提示、韵律感知提示、证据评分提示和对比提示。每种提示抽取3个随机样本，生成12条独立推理轨迹，最终通过多数投票确定预测结果。
AI.result: 所提出的多模态自一致性方法在准确率（52.56%）、精确率（54.03%）、召回率（47.45%）和宏F1分数（46.40%）上均优于基线方法。消融实验表明，移除任一模块都会导致主要指标性能下降。
AI.conclusion: 多模态自一致性方法在MI编码任务上优于单通道基线提示方法。结合"来访者说了什么"（言语内容）和"怎么说的"（声学线索）有助于实现更可靠的自动化MI编码。

title: AssemblyBench: Physics-Aware Assembly of Complex Industrial Objects
summary: Assembling objects from parts requires understanding multimodal instructions, linking them to 3D components, and predicting physically plausible 6-DoF motions for each assembly step. Existing datasets focus on simplified scenarios, overlooking shape complexities and assembly trajectories in industrial assemblies. We introduce AssemblyBench, a synthetic dataset of 2,789 industrial objects with multimodal instruction manuals, corresponding 3D part models, and part assembly trajectories. We also propose a transformer-based model, AssemblyDyno, which uses the instructional manual and the 3D shape of each part to jointly predict assembly order and part assembly trajectories. AssemblyDyno outperforms prior works in both assembly pose estimation and trajectory feasibility, where the latter is evaluated by our physics-based simulations.

AI.tldr: AssemblyBench是一个包含2,789个工业物体的合成数据集，配有模态指令手册、3D零件模型和组装轨迹；AssemblyDyno是一个基于Transformer的模型，利用指令手册和零件3D形状联合预测组装顺序和轨迹，在组装姿态估计和轨迹可行性上优于先前工作。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集忽略了工业组装中的形状复杂性和装配轨迹，缺乏多模态指令与3D组件的结合。
AI.method: 提出合成数据集AssemblyBench和基于Transformer的模型AssemblyDyno，利用指令手册和零件3D形状联合预测组装顺序和零件装配轨迹。
AI.result: AssemblyDyno在组装姿态估计和轨迹可行性上均优于先前工作，后者通过基于物理的仿真评估。
AI.conclusion: AssemblyBench和AssemblyDyno为工业组装任务提供了更真实的数据和更优的模型方案。

title: GRACE: Gradient-aligned Reasoning Data Curation for Efficient Post-training
summary: Existing reasoning data curation pipelines score whole samples, treating every intermediate step as equally valuable. In reality, steps within a trace contribute very unevenly, and selecting reasoning data well requires assessing them individually. We present GRACE, a gradient-aligned curation method that views each reasoning trace as a sequence of optimization events and scores every step by two complementary signals: its alignment with the answer-oriented gradient direction, and its consistency with the preceding reasoning trajectory. Step-level scores are aggregated into a sample-level value for subset selection, using only the model's internal optimization signals and no external reward models or step annotations. To make this scalable, GRACE introduces a representation-level gradient proxy that estimates step-level alignment from token-level upstream signals in a single forward pass. Post-training Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on MMathCoT-1M, GRACE reaches 108.8% of the full-data performance with 20% of the data and retains 100.2% with only 5%, with subsets that transfer effectively across model backbones.

AI.tldr: GRACE提出了一种基于梯度对齐的推理数据筛选方法，通过逐步骤评估推理轨迹的质量，仅用5%数据即可达到全量数据100.2%的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有推理数据筛选方法将整个样本视为整体，忽略了轨迹中各步骤的不均匀贡献，需要一种能区分步骤质量的数据选择方法。
AI.method: 将推理轨迹视为优化事件序列，通过两种信号评分：与答案梯度方向的对齐度、与前序推理轨迹的一致性。利用表示层梯度代理在单次前向传播中估计步骤级对齐，无需外部奖励模型或步骤标注。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct上，GRACE用20%数据达到全量数据108.8%性能，用5%数据保持100.2%性能，且子集可跨模型迁移。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级梯度对齐是一种高效、可扩展的推理数据筛选范式，显著优于整体样本评分方法。

title: Adaptive Steering and Remasking for Safe Generation in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) provide a promising alternative to autoregressive language models by generating text through iterative denoising and bidirectional refinement. However, this iterative generation paradigm also introduces unique safety vulnerabilities when harmful tokens generated at intermediate denoising steps propagate through subsequent refinement processes and eventually induce unsafe outputs. While there are a few attempts to remedy this issue, they either fail to generate safe outputs or generate safe yet low-quality outputs. This motivates us to propose an inference-time defense framework based on the step-wise intervention during the denoising process, which then improves the safety without compromising the output quality. The key component of our framework is a contrastive safety direction (SGD), a latent direction that captures the semantic boundary between harmful and safe generations. We leverage SGD to assess the alignment of generated tokens with harmful semantics at each denoising step. When harmful alignment is detected, our method remasks the corresponding tokens and resumes the denoising process with adaptive steering, where the steering strength is modulated according to the estimated degree of harmfulness. As a plug-and-play module, our method circumvents the need for additional fine-tuning and can be directly incorporated into off-the-shelf diffusion models. The experimental results show that our approaches reduce jailbreak success rates to 0.64% while preserving generation quality close to the original model performance. This confirms the effectiveness of step-wise intervention for safe diffusion language model generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/leeyejin1231/DLM_Steering_Remasking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于推理时干预的扩散语言模型安全防御框架，通过对去噪过程中的有害token进行重新掩码和自适应引导，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下将越狱成功率降至0.64%。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的迭代生成范式存在独特的安全漏洞：中间去噪步骤产生的有害token会在后续精炼过程中传播，最终导致不安全输出。现有方法要么无法生成安全输出，要么生成安全但质量低下的输出。
AI.method: 提出对比安全方向（SGD）来捕捉有害与安全生成之间的语义边界，在每个去噪步骤评估生成token的有害对齐程度。检测到有害对齐时，对相应token进行重新掩码，并基于估计的有害程度自适应调节引导强度继续去噪过程。该方法即插即用，无需额外微调。
AI.result: 将越狱成功率降至0.64%，同时生成质量接近原始模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 逐步干预策略对于安全扩散语言模型生成是有效的。

title: PRISM: Perinuclear Ring-based Image Segmentation Method for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Classification
comment: Paper accepted for publication at the XXVI Simpósio Brasileiro de Computação Aplicada à Saúde (SBCAS 2026), Ouro Preto, MG, Brazil
summary: Automated analysis of peripheral blood smears for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) is hindered by low contrast and substantial variability in cytoplasmic appearance, which complicate conventional membrane-based segmentation. We found that many recent approaches rely on heavy neural architectures and extensive training, but still struggle to generalize across staining and acquisition variability. To address these limitations, we propose the Perinuclear Ring-based Image Segmentation Method (PRISM), which replaces explicit cytoplasmic delineation with adaptive concentric zones constructed around the nucleus. These perinuclear regions enable the extraction of robust cytoplasmic descriptors by integrating color information with texture statistics derived from grey-level co-occurrence patterns, without requiring accurate cell-boundary detection. A calibrated stacking ensemble of traditional classifiers leverages these descriptors to achieve a high performance, with an accuracy of 98.46% and a precision-recall AUC of 0.9937.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于核周环的图像分割方法（PRISM），通过围绕细胞核构建自适应同心区域来替代传统细胞膜分割，结合颜色与纹理特征，用传统分类器集成实现98.46%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 外周血涂片自动分析中，急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）细胞存在低对比度和胞质外观变异大的问题，传统基于膜的分割方法效果不佳，且现有深度学习方法泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出PRISM方法，围绕细胞核构建自适应同心环区域（核周环），提取颜色信息和灰度共生矩阵纹理统计特征，采用校准的堆叠集成传统分类器进行分类。
AI.result: 准确率达到98.46%，精确率-召回率AUC达到0.9937。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过避免细胞边界精确检测，利用核周区域提取稳健的胞质描述符，实现了高精度的ALL细胞分类，且不依赖重型神经网络。

title: A Constraint Programming Approach for $n$-Day Lookahead Playoff Clinching
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to CP 2026
summary: In professional sports, a team has clinched the playoffs if they are guaranteed a postseason spot, regardless of the outcomes of any remaining games. As the season progresses, sports fans and other stakeholders are interested in precisely when, and under what conditions, their team will clinch the playoffs. In this paper, we investigate playoff clinching in the context of the National Hockey League (NHL), where it is computationally challenging to produce clinching scenarios due, in part, to complex tie-breakers. We present an algorithm that determines under which combinations of game outcomes in the next $n$ days a team will clinch the playoffs (i.e., "$n$-day lookahead clinching"). Our approach is a custom tree search which employs various preprocessing techniques, pruning strategies, and node ordering heuristics to efficiently explore the space of possible outcomes. The tree search leverages a constraint programming (CP)-based subroutine for inference that determines if a team has clinched the playoffs for some snapshot in time of the regular season (i.e., "0-day lookahead clinching"). This CP subroutine aims to find a counter-example in which the team being evaluated is eliminated, taking into account qualification rules and the NHL's extensive list of tie-breakers. We validate the efficacy of our algorithm using hundreds of scenarios based on public NHL data for the seasons 2021-22 through 2024-25. The methods introduced can be readily extended to other metrics of interest, including mathematical proof of playoff elimination, clinching the President's Trophy, as well as clinching (or being eliminated from clinching) any other seed in the standings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种算法，用于在NHL中确定球队在未来n天内获得季后赛资格的多种比赛结果组合，通过定制树搜索和约束编程子程序高效解决复杂平局规则下的计算难题。
AI.motivation: 体育迷和利益相关者希望知道球队何时以及在什么条件下能够锁定季后赛资格，但在NHL中由于复杂的平局规则，计算这一场景具有挑战性。
AI.method: 采用定制树搜索算法，结合预处理技术、剪枝策略和节点排序启发式，并利用基于约束编程的子程序进行推理，判断球队是否已锁定季后赛资格。
AI.result: 使用2021-22至2024-25赛季的数百个真实NHL场景验证了算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可扩展至其他指标，如数学上证明季后赛淘汰、总统奖杯锁定，以及任何种子排名的锁定或淘汰。

title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking
summary: Most existing large language models (LLMs) are expensive to adapt after deployment, especially when a task requires newly produced information or niche domain knowledge. Recent work has shown that, by manipulating and optimizing their context, LLMs can be tailored to downstream tasks without updating their weights. However, most existing methods remain closed-loop, relying solely on the model's intrinsic knowledge. In this paper, we equip these context optimizers with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking. We show that naively adding these tools to a standard sequential context optimization pipeline can actually degrade performance compared to baselines. However, when paired with a search-based training procedure that maintains and prunes multiple candidate contexts, active information seeking delivers consistent and substantial gains. We demonstrate these improvements across diverse domains, including low-resource translation (Flores+), health scenarios (HealthBench), and reasoning-heavy tasks (LiveCodeBench and Humanity's Last Exam). Furthermore, our method proves to be data-efficient, robust across different hyperparameters, and capable of generating effective textual contexts that generalize well across different models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合搜索工具的多候选上下文优化方法，通过维护和剪枝多个候选上下文，显著提升了LLM在下游任务中的表现，且无需更新模型权重。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM部署后适配成本高，尤其在需要新信息或专业领域知识时。现有上下文优化方法仅依赖模型内在知识，且简单添加搜索工具反而会降低性能。
AI.method: 为LLM配备Wikipedia搜索和浏览器工具进行主动信息获取，并设计一种基于搜索的训练流程，维护和剪枝多个候选上下文，而非简单的顺序优化。
AI.result: 在低资源翻译、健康场景和推理密集型任务等多个领域均取得持续且显著的性能提升，且方法数据高效、超参数鲁棒、生成的上下文可跨模型泛化。
AI.conclusion: 结合搜索工具的多候选上下文优化方法能有效弥补模型知识局限，显著增强LLM的下游任务适配能力，且具有良好的实用性和泛化性。

title: Strikingness-Aware Evaluation for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning (TKGR) aims at inferring missing (especially future) events from historical data. Current evaluation in TKGR uniformly weights all events, ignoring that most are trivial repetitions, which overestimate the true reasoning ability. Therefore, the rare outstanding events, whose prediction demands deeper reasoning, should be distinguished and emphasized. To this end, we propose a strikingness-aware evaluation framework, which introduces a rule-based strikingness measuring framework (RSMF) to quantify event strikingness by comparing its expected occurrence with peer events derived from temporal rules. Strikingness is then integrated as a weighting factor into metrics like weighted MRR and Hits@k. Experiments on four TKG benchmarks reveal: 1) All representative models perform worse as event strikingness increases, 2) Path-based methods excel on low-strikingness events and representation-based ones on high-strikingness events, 3) We design an ensemble method whose gains stem from fitting trivial events rather than reasoning improvement. Our framework provides a more rigorous evaluation, refocusing the field on predicting outstanding events.

AI.tldr: 当前时态知识图谱推理评估对所有事件均匀加权，忽略了大多数是平凡重复事件，导致高估推理能力。本文提出基于显著性的评估框架，通过规则衡量事件显著性并加权到指标中，实验发现模型在显著性高的事件上表现更差，且集成方法的提升来自拟合平凡事件而非推理改进。
AI.motivation: 现有TKGR评估统一加权所有事件，但大部分事件是平凡重复，导致评估结果高估了模型的真实推理能力，需要区分和强调那些需要更深推理的罕见显著事件。
AI.method: 提出基于规则的显著性衡量框架（RSMF），通过比较事件与其从时序规则推导的对等事件的期望出现情况来量化事件显著性，然后将显著性作为加权因子整合到MRR和Hits@k等指标中。
AI.result: 1）所有代表性模型在事件显著性增加时表现更差；2）基于路径的方法在低显著性事件上表现好，基于表示的方法在高显著性事件上表现好；3）设计的集成方法的提升来自拟合平凡事件而非推理改进。
AI.conclusion: 提出的显著性感知评估框架提供了更严格的评估标准，将领域关注点重新聚焦于预测显著（真正需要推理）的事件。

title: The Cost of Perfect English: Pragmatic Flattening and the Erasure of Authorial Voice in L2 Writing Supported by GenAI
summary: The integration of Generative AI (GenAI) into language learning offers second language (L2) writers powerful tools for text optimization. However, pursuing native-like fluency often sacrifices sociopragmatic diversity. Investigating "pragmatic flattening" - the systematic erasure of culturally preferred politeness and authorial stance - this study conducts a comparative analysis of argumentative essays by Chinese B2-level university students from the ICNALE corpus. The original texts were polished via the APIs of four leading Large Language Models at a zero-temperature setting for reproducibility. Findings reveal a nuanced "dimensional divergence" within the Semantic Preservation Paradox. While models corrected lexicogrammatical errors and retained propositional meaning, sociopragmatic interventions were bifurcated. In the interactive dimension, all models showed a drastic collapse of dialogic engagement markers, turning negotiated discourse into monologic assertions. Conversely, in the epistemic stance dimension, models showed architecture-based variability: some aggressively scrubbed epistemic markers, while others reinforced tentative hedging as decontextualized algorithmic caution. This confirms that while GenAI enhances accuracy, it systematically overwrites L2 writers' unique rhetorical identities into a homogenized Anglo-American paradigm. We argue that future instruction must move beyond error correction, advocating for Critical AI Literacy to empower multilingual writers to use GenAI for linguistic enhancement while safeguarding sociopragmatic diversity and rhetorical agency.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了生成式AI对二语写作者语用多样性的影响，发现AI虽能修正语言错误，但会系统性地消除文化偏好性的礼貌和作者立场，导致"语用扁平化"现象。
AI.motivation: 揭示生成式AI在优化二语写作时，追求母语般流利度可能牺牲社会语用多样性的问题。
AI.method: 对ICNALE语料库中中国B2级大学生的议论文，通过四种大语言模型API在零温度设置下进行润色，比较原文与润色文本的语用特征变化。
AI.result: 发现"语义保留悖论"中的维度分歧：模型虽修正词法语法错误并保留命题意义，但在互动维度上消除了对话参与标记，在认知立场维度上表现出架构差异性，或消除或强化了认知标记。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI会系统性地将二语写作者的独特修辞身份同质化为盎格鲁-美式范式，未来教学应超越纠错，提倡批判性AI素养以保护语用多样性和修辞主体性。

title: Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics
summary: As automated reasoning systems advance rapidly, there is a growing need for research-level formal mathematical problems to accurately evaluate their capabilities. To address this, we present Formal Conjectures, an evolving benchmark of currently 2615 mathematical problem statements formalized in Lean 4. Sourced from areas of active mathematical research, the dataset features 1029 open research conjectures providing a zero-contamination benchmark for mathematical proof discovery, and 836 solved problems for proof autoformalization. Notably, the repository provides a structured interface connecting mathematicians who formalize and clarify problems with the AI systems and humans attempting to solve them. Demonstrating its immediate utility, the benchmark has already been leveraged to make new mathematical discoveries, including the resolution of open research conjectures. We describe our approach to ensuring the correctness of these formalizations in a collaborative open-source project where contributions stem from an active community. In this framework, AI-generated proofs and disproofs serve as a valuable auditing mechanism to iteratively improve the fidelity of the benchmark. Finally, we provide a standardized evaluation setup and report baseline results on frozen evaluation subsets, demonstrating a climbable signal that measures the current frontier of automated reasoning on research-level mathematics.

AI.tldr: 提出了Formal Conjectures基准，包含2615个Lean 4形式化数学问题，其中1029个开放研究猜想用于定理证明，836个已解决问题用于证明自动形式化，并展示了其在自动化推理评估和新数学发现中的实用性。
AI.motivation: 随着自动化推理系统的快速发展，需要研究级别的正式数学问题来准确评估其能力，而现有的基准测试在问题的新颖性和无污染性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 构建了Formal Conjectures基准，包含2615个Lean 4形式化的数学问题陈述，其中1029个开放研究猜想和836个已解决问题；采用协作开源社区方式确保形式化正确性；利用AI生成的证明和反证作为审计机制；提供标准化评估设置和冻结子集。
AI.result: 该基准已被用于产生新的数学发现，包括解决开放研究猜想；在冻结评估子集上报告了基准结果，展示了可攀爬的信号，衡量了当前自动化推理在研究级数学上的前沿水平。
AI.conclusion: Formal Conjectures作为一个不断进化的基准，通过连接数学家和AI系统，为研究级数学的自动化推理评估提供了零污染、可迭代改进的标准化平台。

title: Scaling few-shot spoken word classification with generative meta-continual learning
summary: Few-shot spoken word classification has largely been developed for applications where a small number of classes is considered, and so the potential of larger-scale few-shot spoken word classification remains untapped. This paper investigates the potential of a spoken word classifier to sequentially learn to distinguish between 1000 classes when it is given only five shots per class. We demonstrate that this scaling capability exists by training a model using the Generative Meta-Continual Learning (GeMCL) algorithm and comparing it to repeatedly trained or finetuned baselines. We find that GeMCL produces exceptionally stable performance, and although it does not always outperform a repeatedly fully-finetuned HuBERT model nor a frozen HuBERT model with a repeatedly trained classifier head, it produces comparable performance to the latter while adapting 2000 times faster, having been trained less than half of the data for two orders of magnitude less time.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大规模少样本口语单词分类，使用GeMCL算法在1000个类别、每类仅5个样本的情况下，实现了与全微调HuBERT模型相当的性能，但训练速度快了2000倍，数据量少了一半以上。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本口语单词分类主要针对少量类别，大规模场景下的潜力尚未被探索。本文旨在探究口语单词分类器在1000个类别、每类仅5个样本条件下进行顺序学习的能力。
AI.method: 使用生成式元持续学习（GeMCL）算法训练模型，并与重复训练或微调的基线模型（包括全微调HuBERT和冻结HuBERT+重复训练分类头）进行对比。
AI.result: GeMCL表现出极其稳定的性能；虽然并非始终优于全微调HuBERT或冻结HuBERT+重复训练分类头，但与后者性能相当，同时适应速度快了2000倍，训练数据量少了一半以上，训练时间少了两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 大规模少样本口语单词分类是可行的，GeMCL算法在性能与效率之间取得了良好平衡，为实际应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: GuardMarkGS: Unified Ownership Tracing and Edit Deterrence for 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is becoming a practical representation for novel view synthesis, but its growing adoption, together with rapid advances in instruction-driven 3DGS editing, also exposes a dual copyright risk: once a 3DGS-based asset is released, it can be used without permission and manipulated through 3D editing. Existing protection methods address only one side of this problem. Watermarking can trace ownership after unauthorized use, but it cannot prevent malicious editing. Adversarial edit-deterrence methods can disrupt editing, but they do not provide evidence of ownership. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first unified protection framework for 3DGS that jointly optimizes ownership tracing and unauthorized editing deterrence. Our framework combines a scene-wide watermarking objective over all Gaussians with an adversarial objective for edit deterrence. The adversarial branch combines latent-anchor separation, denoising-trajectory diversion, and cross-attention diversion to divert the editing trajectory, while an update-saliency-motivated Gaussian selection strategy assigns stronger adversarial updates to mask-selected Gaussians, improving the balance among watermark recovery, edit deterrence, and rendering fidelity. Experiments on scenes from Mip-NeRF 360 and Instruct-NeRF2NeRF demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a favorable balance among bit accuracy, edit deterrence, and rendering quality. These results suggest that practical copyright protection of 3DGS-based assets can be more effectively addressed by integrating ownership tracing and unauthorized editing deterrence into a single optimization framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个统一的3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)版权保护框架，联合优化所有权追踪和未授权编辑阻止，通过水印目标与对抗目标的结合，在比特准确率、编辑阻止和渲染质量之间取得良好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有3DGS版权保护方法仅解决单一问题：水印可追溯所有权但无法阻止恶意编辑；对抗性编辑阻止方法可干扰编辑但无法提供所有权证据。亟需统一框架同时解决这两方面版权风险。
AI.method: 框架联合优化场景级水印目标和对抗性编辑阻止目标。对抗分支结合潜锚点分离、降噪轨迹偏移和交叉注意力偏移来干扰编辑轨迹，同时采用更新显著性驱动的高斯选择策略，为掩码选择的高斯分配更强对抗更新。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360和Instruct-NeRF2NeRF场景上的实验表明，该框架在比特准确率、编辑阻止和渲染质量之间实现了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 将所有权追踪和未授权编辑阻止整合到单一优化框架中，能更有效地实现3DGS资产的实用版权保护。

title: Hierarchical Attacks for Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: Multi-modal multi-agent systems (MM-MAS) have gained increasing attention for their capacity to enable complex reasoning and coordination across diverse modalities. As these systems continue to expand in scale and functionality, investigating their potential vulnerabilities has become increasingly important. However, existing studies on adversarial attacks in multi-agent systems primarily focus on isolated agents or unimodal settings, leaving the vulnerabilities of MM-MAS largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAM$^{3}$, a Hierarchical Attack framework for multi-modal multi-agent systems that decomposes attacks into three interconnected layers. Specifically, at the perception layer, HAM$^{3}$ mounts attacks by perturbing visual inputs, textual inputs, and their fused visual-textual representations. At the communication layer, it performs communication-level attacks that corrupt message content and interaction topology, such as manipulating shared context or communication links to distort collective information flow. At the reasoning layer, it conducts reasoning-level attacks that interfere with each agent's cognitive pipeline, biasing reasoning trajectories and ultimately compromising final decisions. We evaluate HAM$^{3}$ on the GQA benchmark through multi-agent systems built on distinct reasoning paradigms including ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Reflexion. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves an Attack Success Rate of up to 78.3%, with reasoning-layer attacks being the most effective. More than half of the successful attacks lead multiple agents to produce consistent errors. These findings offer valuable insights for building more robust and interpretable multi-agent intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAM³，一个针对多模态多智能体系统的分层攻击框架，从感知层、通信层和推理层三个层面实施攻击，在GQA基准测试中最高达到78.3%的攻击成功率，其中推理层攻击效果最显著。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究主要聚焦于单智能体或单模态场景，多模态多智能体系统的脆弱性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出HAM³分层攻击框架，包含三层：感知层（扰动视觉、文本及视觉-文本融合表示）、通信层（破坏消息内容和交互拓扑）、推理层（干扰智能体认知管道，偏置推理轨迹）。在ReAct、Plan-and-Solve、Reflexion三种推理范式上评估。
AI.result: 攻击成功率最高达78.3%，推理层攻击最为有效，超过一半的成功攻击可导致多个智能体产生一致错误。
AI.conclusion: 为构建更鲁棒和可解释的多智能体系统提供了重要 insights。

title: TruncProof: A Guardrail for LLM-based JSON Generation under Token-Length Constraints
comment: Main paper (8 pages). Accepted at the International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026)
summary: The LLM-based generation of machine-readable outputs such as JSON has attracted significant attention for integration with external systems. However, existing approaches cannot strictly enforce the maximum number of tokens to be generated, leading to infinite generation or truncated outputs that cause a system malfunction. To address this limitation, we propose TruncProof, a novel grammar-constrained generation method that enables LLMs to produce grammatically valid JSONs while adhering to a predefined token limit. By leveraging the properties of LL(1) parsers, TruncProof efficiently approximates the minimum number of tokens required to complete a grammatically valid output at each decoding step. Experiments on the Text-to-JSON instruction tasks demonstrate that TruncProof successfully generates syntactically correct outputs even under strict token constraints. Furthermore, we show that TruncProof can be effectively combined with advanced decoding strategies, resulting in outputs that are not only grammatically valid but also semantically accurate.

AI.tldr: 提出TruncProof方法，在LLM生成JSON时严格约束token数量上限，确保语法正确性，并兼容高级解码策略。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法严格限制生成token数量，导致无限生成或截断输出，引发系统故障。
AI.method: TruncProof是一种基于语法约束的生成方法，利用LL(1)解析器特性，在每个解码步骤高效估算完成合法输出所需的最小token数，从而在预设token限制内生成语法有效的JSON。
AI.result: 在Text-to-JSON指令任务上，TruncProof能在严格token约束下生成语法正确的输出，且结合高级解码策略时可同时保证语法有效性和语义准确性。
AI.conclusion: TruncProof有效解决了LLM生成JSON时token数量不可控的问题，实现了语法正确性与长度约束的统一。

title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
summary: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向云制造中无人机联合物流与移动边缘计算混合调度问题的智能优化框架，采用大语言模型驱动的数学建模与分层深度强化学习相结合的方法，实现了99.6%的产品收集成功率和100%的任务截止时间满足率。
AI.motivation: 无人机在云制造中同时承担产品收集与移动边缘计算服务，导致物流路由决策与计算任务调度深度耦合，传统方法难以同时优化两类异构决策。
AI.method: 提出智能体AI辅助优化框架：1）结合大语言模型、检索增强生成和思维链推理，将用户输入自动转化为可解释的数学模型；2）设计基于PPO的分层深度强化学习，上层学习无人机路由，下层优化每个时隙的任务执行与资源分配。
AI.result: 分层PPO在最后500个训练回合中实现99.6%的产品收集完成率，100%的截止时间满足率，且性能稳定性优于优势动作评价方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的智能体AI+分层强化学习框架有效解决了物流与计算调度的联合优化问题，在性能与稳定性上均优于对比方法。

title: Does language matter for spoken word classification? A multilingual generative meta-learning approach
summary: Meta-learning has been shown to have better performance than supervised learning for few-shot monolingual spoken word classification. However, the meta-learning approach remains under-explored in multilingual spoken word classification. In this paper, we apply the Generative Meta-Continual Learning algorithm to spoken word classification. The generative nature of this algorithm makes it viable for use in application, and the meta-learning aspect promotes generalisation, which is crucial in a multilingual setting. We train monolingual models on English, German, French, and Catalan, a bilingual model on English and German, and a multilingual model on all four languages. We find that although the multilingual model performs best, the differences between model performance is unexpectedly low. We also find that the hours of unique data seen during training seems to be a stronger performance indicator than the number of languages included in the training data.

AI.tldr: 本文将生成式元持续学习算法应用于多语言口语单词分类，发现多语言模型表现最佳，但模型间性能差异意外地小，且训练中看到的独特数据小时数比语言数量更影响性能。
AI.motivation: 元学习在少样本单语口语单词分类中已优于监督学习，但在多语言场景下尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用生成式元持续学习算法，分别训练英语、德语、法语、加泰罗尼亚语的单语模型，英语-德语双语模型，以及涵盖所有四种语言的多语言模型。
AI.result: 多语言模型表现最佳，但各模型间性能差异意外地小；训练中看到的独特数据小时数比语言数量更能预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 生成式元持续学习在多语言口语单词分类中有效，数据多样性比语言数量更重要。

title: AuraMask: An Extensible Pipeline for Developing Aesthetic Anti-Facial Recognition Image Filters
summary: Anti-facial recognition (AFR) image filters alter images in ways that are subtle to people but blinding to computer vision. Yet, despite widespread interest in these technologies to subvert surveillance, users rarely use them in practice -- because the ``subtle'' alterations are visible enough to conflict with users' self-presentation goals. To address this challenge, we propose AuraMask: a novel approach to creating AFR filters that are both adversarially effective and aesthetically acceptable. Using AuraMask, we produce 40 ``aesthetic'' filters that emulate popular ``one-click'' Instagram image filters. We show that AuraMask filters meet or exceed the adversarial effectiveness of prior methods against open-source facial recognition models. Moreover, in a controlled online user study ($N=630$) we confirm these filters achieve significantly higher user acceptance than prior methods. Lastly, we provide our AFR pipeline to the community for accelerated research in adversarially effective and aesthetically acceptable protections.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuraMask方法，在保持对抗有效性的同时，通过模拟流行Instagram滤镜提升反人脸识别滤镜的美学可接受性，用户接受度显著高于以往方法。
AI.motivation: 现有反人脸识别滤镜虽然能欺骗计算机视觉系统，但其视觉上的"微妙"变化对用户来说仍然可见，与用户的自我呈现目标相冲突，导致实际使用率低。
AI.method: 提出AuraMask方法，创建40种模拟Instagram滤镜风格的"美学"反人脸识别滤镜，在保证对抗有效性的同时提升视觉可接受性。
AI.result: AuraMask滤镜在对抗开源人脸识别模型方面达到或超过以往方法的有效性；在630名用户的在线研究中，用户接受度显著高于以往方法。
AI.conclusion: AuraMask成功平衡了反人脸识别滤镜的对抗有效性与美学可接受性，并将向社区开源以加速相关研究。

title: Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization
comment: Accepted in the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI 2016)
summary: LLMs have shown immense potential for code translation, yet they often struggle to ensure both syntactic correctness and semantic consistency. While preference-based learning offers a promising alignment strategy, it is hindered by unreliable semantic rewards derived from sparse test cases or restrictive reference translations. We argue that a robust semantic reward for code translation must be derived directly from the source code. In this paper, we propose CTO to improve code translation with syntax-guided and semantic-aware preference optimization. Through contrastive learning, we train a cross-lingual semantic model to directly assess functional equivalence between source and translated code. By formulating code translation as a multi-objective optimization problem, this robust semantic signal is seamlessly unified with compiler-based syntactic feedback within the direct preference optimization framework. Extensive experiments on C++, Java, and Python translations demonstrate that CTO significantly outperforms existing baselines and alternative preference optimization strategies.

AI.tldr: CTO提出了一种结合语法引导和语义感知的偏好优化方法，用于提升LLM代码翻译的语法正确性和语义一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有代码翻译方法难以同时保证语法正确性和语义一致性，基于偏好的学习因测试用例稀疏或参考翻译限制而导致语义奖励不可靠。
AI.method: 通过对比学习训练跨语言语义模型直接评估源与翻译代码的功能等价性，将代码翻译建模为多目标优化问题，将语义信号与编译器语法反馈统一到直接偏好优化框架中。
AI.result: 在C++、Java和Python翻译任务上，CTO显著优于现有基线方法和替代偏好优化策略。
AI.conclusion: 直接从源代码推导的鲁棒语义奖励能有效提升代码翻译质量，语法与语义联合优化的框架具有优越性。

title: It's not the Language Model, it's the Tool: Deterministic Mediation for Scientific Workflows
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 2 appendices. Submitted to SETN 2026
summary: Language models can produce convincing scientific analyses, but repeated generations on the same data do not guarantee the same result. A researcher may regenerate an identical query and receive a different fit, a different peak position or a different analysis procedure, without an obvious way to decide which output to trust. We propose typed mediation, a pattern in which the model orchestrates deterministic tools rather than generating analytical code. Each tool encodes one researcher's exact procedure for one instrument, ported through structured interviews. The model selects which tool to call and with what parameters. The tool produces the result. Regeneration does not change it. We evaluate this claim by running the same photoluminescence analysis on four platforms, including three commercial foundation models, four times each with the same prompt. The typed tool produces identical results across all runs. The commercial platforms either vary in numerical output and analytical methodology across runs, or fail to produce valid results on the task. We deploy this pattern on two instruments serving users over approximately six months, with very positive user feedback. Both cases are very challenging: they involve proprietary binary formats and per-seat licensed software, which force the tool to remain on local infrastructure alongside the data and the instrument it operates. We argue that deployment topology is not just a preference, but a structural requirement of scientific tool mediation. The result is a practical pattern for deploying language models in scientific workflows where reproducibility is mandatory, reducing analysis time from weeks to minutes while guaranteeing identical outputs across runs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"类型化中介"模式，让语言模型调用确定性工具而非生成分析代码，以解决科学分析中LLM输出不可重复的问题。在四个平台上测试，该模式生成结果完全一致，而商业模型结果各异。在实际仪器上部署六个月，反馈积极。
AI.motivation: 语言模型生成科学分析结果不可重复，同一查询多次生成可能得到不同结果，研究者无法判断哪个输出可信，亟需一种保证科学分析可重复性的方法。
AI.method: 提出"类型化中介"模式：语言模型不生成分析代码，而是调用封装了研究人员精确分析流程的确定性工具。通过结构化访谈将专家流程移植到工具中，模型仅选择调用哪个工具及参数，工具返回确定性结果。
AI.result: 在四个平台（含三个商业基础模型）上对同一光致发光分析分别运行四次，类型化工具所有运行结果完全相同，商业平台或在数值和分析方法上变化，或无法产生有效结果。实际部署两个仪器约六个月，用户反馈非常积极。
AI.conclusion: 类型化中介是一种实用的科学工作流部署模式，能将分析时间从数周缩短至几分钟，同时保证跨运行输出完全一致。部署拓扑（工具保留在本地基础设施）不仅是偏好，更是科学工具中介的结构性要求。

title: GateKD: Confidence-Gated Closed-Loop Distillation for Robust Reasoning
summary: Distilling multi-step reasoning abilities from large language models (LLMs) into compact student models remains challenging due to noisy rationales, hallucinated supervision, and static teacher-student interactions. Existing reasoning distillation methods, including mentor-based approaches, predominantly operate in an open-loop manner, implicitly assuming uniform teacher reliability and consequently propagating erroneous intermediate reasoning. We propose GateKD, a confidence-gated closed-loop distillation framework that enables robust reasoning transfer by treating the teacher as a dynamic gatekeeper rather than a static oracle. GateKD introduces three complementary mechanisms: (i) confidence-gated soft supervision that selectively distills reliable predictive signals, (ii) gated hidden-state evolution that aligns intermediate representations only when teacher confidence is high, and (iii) reliability-filtered attention distillation that preserves stable reasoning structures while suppressing noisy patterns. These components jointly form a closed feedback loop in which teacher confidence continuously modulates the distillation process, reducing hallucination transfer and stabilizing student reasoning. Extensive experiments across commonsense, logical, and symbolic reasoning benchmarks, using T5 and Flan-T5 backbones of varying sizes, demonstrate that GateKD consistently outperforms strong open-loop distillation baselines. Notably, GateKD yields substantial gains in logical and symbolic reasoning, remains robust under low-resource distillation settings, and shows clear performance degradation when any gating component is removed. Our results highlight that confidence-gated closed-loop supervision is critical for building reliable and scalable small reasoning models.

AI.tldr: GateKD提出了一种置信度门控的闭环知识蒸馏框架，通过动态门控机制选择性传递可靠推理信号，显著提升了小模型在多步推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型推理能力蒸馏方法存在噪声推理、幻觉监督以及静态师生交互等问题，导致错误中间推理被传播，影响了小模型的推理质量。
AI.method: GateKD包含三种互补机制：置信度门控软监督、门控隐状态演化、可靠性过滤注意力蒸馏，三者形成闭环反馈，由教师置信度持续调控蒸馏过程。
AI.result: 在常识、逻辑和符号推理基准上，GateKD一致优于强开环蒸馏基线，尤其在逻辑和符号推理上提升显著，且低资源蒸馏下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 置信度门控的闭环监督对于构建可靠且可扩展的小规模推理模型至关重要。

title: DirectTryOn: One-Step Virtual Try-On via Straightened Conditional Transport
summary: Recent diffusion- and flow-based VTON methods achieve strong results with pretrained generative models, but their reliance on multi-step sampling incurs high inference cost, while existing acceleration methods largely overlook the intrinsic structure of the try-on task. In this paper, we highlight a key observation: VTON outputs are highly constrained by the conditional inputs, suggesting that the conditional sampling trajectory can be much straighter than that in general image generation, making one-step generation a natural solution. However, limited task-specific data makes training from scratch impractical, forcing existing methods to fine-tune pretrained models whose objectives do not encourage such straight conditional trajectories. Thus, the deviation from an ideal straight path mainly comes from the mismatch between pretrained base models and the conditional nature of try-on generation, rather than from the task itself. Motivated by this insight, we encourage straighter VTON sampling trajectories through three targeted modifications: pure conditional transport, a garment preservation loss, and a self consistency loss. We further introduce a one-step distillation stage. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with one-step sampling, establishing a new standard for efficient and high-quality VTON.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散模型的一步式虚拟试穿方法，通过三项关键改进（纯条件传输、服装保留损失、自一致性损失）和蒸馏阶段，实现了SOTA性能与高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有VTON方法依赖多步采样，推理成本高；而加速方法忽略了试穿任务本身具有高度条件约束的结构特性，导致效率与质量难以兼得。
AI.method: 首先观察到VTON输出受条件输入高度约束，采样轨迹理论上可更直；基于此，提出三项改进：1）纯条件传输，2）服装保留损失，3）自一致性损失；并引入一步蒸馏阶段，使模型实现单步高质量生成。
AI.result: 在一步采样条件下，方法达到了SOTA性能，显著提升了VTON的推理效率与生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 证明了利用任务内在条件约束性，通过针对性的训练目标和蒸馏，可以在不依赖多步采样的前提下实现高效、高质量的虚拟试穿，为高效VTON设立了新标准。

title: Respecting Self-Uncertainty in On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation trains a reasoning model on its own rollouts while a teacher, often the same model conditioned on privileged context, provides dense token-level supervision. Existing objectives typically weight the teacher's token-level signal uniformly across a chain-of-thought sequence, despite substantial variation in the entropy of the teacher's predictive distribution. We propose EGRSD (Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation), which unifies token-level updates through three signals: a reward-grounded direction, a teacher-student likelihood-ratio magnitude, and the proposed teacher-entropy confidence gate that down-weights high-entropy token positions while maintaining a nonzero lower bound on every token weight. We further introduce CL-EGRSD, a causal-lookahead variant that distinguishes sustained high-entropy spans from transient high-entropy positions whose following context rapidly becomes low entropy. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode show that EGRSD and CL-EGRSD advance the accuracy-length frontier among the compared trainable methods.

AI.tldr: 提出EGRSD和CL-EGRSD方法，通过熵引导的置信门控机制对自蒸馏中的token级信号进行加权，在Qwen3模型上提升了准确率-长度前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏方法对teacher模型的token级信号采用均匀加权，忽略了teacher预测分布熵的显著变化，导致高熵（不确定）位置被过度优化。
AI.method: EGRSD统一了三种信号：奖励引导方向、师生似然比幅度、以及教师熵置信门控（降低高熵token权重但保持非零下界）。CL-EGRSD进一步区分持续高熵区间与短暂高熵位置。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B的thinking模式下，EGRSD和CL-EGRSD在准确率-长度前沿上优于其他可训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过熵感知的token级加权策略，可以更有效地进行自蒸馏训练，在保持推理能力的同时优化token级监督信号的质量。

title: Debunking Grad-ECLIP: A Comprehensive Study on Its Incorrectness and Fundamental Principles for Model Interpretation
summary: Grad-ECLIP is published at ICML 2024 and represents a new Transformer interpretation technical route (intermediate features-based). First, this paper demonstrates that the intermediate features-based technical route is not a novel one.
